## Hotcoin TradFi 0 Fee Carnival | Enjoy Zero Trading Fees & Win a Share of 500,000 USDT!
Hotcoin
Share
Dear Hotcoiners,
Exciting TradFi trading benefits are here! The Hotcoin TradFi 0 Fee Carnival kicks off soon!
During the campaign, all users, both new and existing, can enjoy zero trading fees across all TradFi products. Trade gold, forex, U.S. stocks, major global indices, and more while exploring opportunities across global markets!
Plus, complete the required trading tasks to earn a share of the 500,000 USDT prize pool! The higher your cumulative trading volume, the bigger your rewards, with up to 100 USDT per user!
Sign-up Now
Campaign Period: 2026-11-21 00:00 – 2026-12-04 23:59 (UTC+8)
## Event 1: Zero Trading Fees Across All TradFi Products
During the campaign, all Hotcoin users can enjoy zero trading fees across all available TradFi products on the platform, helping reduce trading costs.
## Event 2: Trade More & Share a 500,000 USDT Prize Pool!
During the campaign, users can unlock tiered rewards by reaching cumulative eligible trading volume milestones in TradFi Spot and Futures trading, with up to 100 USDT per user!
## Eligible TradFi Trading Volume · Reward
≥ 1,000 USDT · 5 USDT
≥ 5,000 USDT · 10 USDT
≥ 20,000 USDT · 20 USDT
≥ 50,000 USDT · 50 USDT
≥ 100,000 USDT · 100 USDT
## Terms & Conditions
Users must log in to Hotcoin and click "Join Now" on the campaign page to register. Trading activity from unregistered users will not count toward Event 2 rewards.
Event 1 is open to all Hotcoin users. 100% of eligible TradFi trading fees incurred during the campaign will be rebated as Futures Trial Funds, after deducting agent commissions.
Event 1 rebates exclude agent commissions, spreads, overnight interest, funding fees, and other trading costs. Final rebate amounts are subject to Hotcoin's calculations and verification.
Event 2 is based on cumulative eligible TradFi Spot and Futures trading volume during the campaign. Only the highest tier achieved applies; rewards from different tiers cannot be combined.
The campaign covers all TradFi products available on Hotcoin, including gold, forex, U.S. stocks, and major global indices, subject to actual availability.
Only genuine, eligible trades executed during the campaign will count toward trading volume. Abnormal trading, wash trading, self-trading, and other prohibited activities will be excluded.
The campaign features two separate prize pools: 100,000 USDT for Event 1 fee rebates (up to 300 USDT per user) and 500,000 USDT for Event 2 trading rewards. Each event follows its own rules, with rewards available until the respective prize pool is exhausted.
All rewards will be distributed as Futures Trial Funds within 7 business days after the campaign ends and data verification is completed. The types, denominations, validity periods, and usage rules are subject to the details displayed on the relevant Hotcoin product pages.
Users who engage in bulk account registrations, malicious arbitrage, fraudulent trading, or other prohibited activities may be disqualified and have their rewards revoked.
Hotcoin reserves the right to modify, interpret, or terminate this campaign to the extent permitted by applicable law.
Thank you for your continued support and trust in Hotcoin.

Headline: KuCoin KCUSD: Last 5 days to enjoy up to 7% APR on KCUSD!
Start: not stated · End: 2026-11-27T04:00:44Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Register during the campaign, transfer USDT or USDC into KuCoin from an external wallet or platform, and use these assets to subscribe to KCUSD, a KuCoin Earn product. Eligible users can receive 30 days of bonus APR in addition to base rewards, bringing the total APR to up to 7%. Limited to the first 3,000 eligible users. First come, first served.
30-Day Average Daily Eligible Net Deposits (USDT Equivalent) | Base APR | Bonus APR | Total Campaign APR
50,000 ≤ Net Deposit < 100,000 | 4% | 2% | 6%
Net Deposit ≥ 100,000 | 4% | 3% | 7%
Both tiers provide a 30-day reward period, with a maximum reward principal of 1,000,000 KCUSD per user.
The indicative total APR combines the current 4% KCUSD base APR with the applicable campaign bonus APR. The base APR is variable, and the rate displayed on the KCUSD product page prevails.
## How to Participate
## Complete the following steps before the campaign deadline:
- Register: Click the registration button on this page to join the campaign.
- Deposit: Transfer USDT or USDC into KuCoin from an external wallet or another trading platform.
- Subscribe to KCUSD: Use the deposited assets to subscribe to KCUSD and hold it during your observation period to earn eligible bonus rewards.
Your individual observation period runs for 30 consecutive days from the date of your first eligible deposit during the campaign. Registration, additional deposits, and subsequent subscriptions do not restart or extend it. Users who complete these steps on the final campaign day can still complete their full individual observation period.
## How Your APR Tier Is Determined
Your balance at the end of the campaign does not, by itself, determine your tier. We calculate your average daily eligible net deposits over your individual 30-day observation period to determine the applicable bonus APR.
30-Day Average Daily Eligible Net Deposits = Sum of Daily Cumulative Eligible Net Deposit Balances During the Observation Period ÷ 30
Each daily cumulative balance equals eligible external deposits counted from the start of the campaign through that day, minus external withdrawals over the same period. The calculation averages your cumulative daily balances rather than dividing the sum of your daily deposits by 30.
For example, if you deposit 100,000 USDT on the first day and make no additional deposits or withdrawals for 30 days, your daily cumulative balance and average daily eligible net deposits will both be 100,000 USDT. This qualifies for the 3% bonus APR tier.
An average below 50,000 USDT equivalent does not qualify for campaign bonus rewards.
## How Your Bonus Reward Is Caculated
## Eligible net deposits and KCUSD holdings are averaged separately over the same 30-day observation period.
30-Day Average Daily KCUSD Holdings = Sum of Daily KCUSD Snapshot Balances During the Observation Period ÷ 30
## Your reward principal is the lowest of
- Your 30-day average daily eligible net deposits;
- Your 30-day average daily KCUSD holdings;
- 1,000,000 KCUSD.
## Bonus Reward = Reward Principal × Applicable Bonus APR × 30 ÷ 365
Both averages use the full 30-day period. Days without KCUSD holdings count as zero, and no separate minimum daily holding requirement applies. You may withdraw or redeem according to your funding needs, but these actions may reduce your average net deposits, average KCUSD holdings, and final reward.
## Calculation Example
If your average daily eligible net deposits are 150,000 USDT and your average daily KCUSD holdings are 120,000 KCUSD, you qualify for a 3% bonus APR on a reward principal of 120,000 KCUSD.
## Your estimated campaign bonus reward is: 120,000 × 3% × 30 ÷ 365 ≈ 295.89 KCUSD
This amount excludes KCUSD base rewards, which are calculated and distributed separately under the product rules. Actual campaign rewards are subject to the final calculation.
## Eligible Deposits and Transfers
Only USDT and USDC transferred to KuCoin during the campaign from an external wallet, blockchain address, or another trading platform qualify as eligible external deposits, measured in USDT equivalent.
Eligible deposits and external withdrawals made during the campaign before registration are included. Registration does not reset your observation period. Deposits made after the campaign ends are excluded, while external withdrawals made before your individual observation period ends continue to be deducted.
Internal transfers do not count toward eligible net deposits. These include transfers between KuCoin accounts, between main accounts and sub-accounts, and between Funding, Trading, Earn, or other internal accounts. Subscribing to KCUSD using existing funds redeemed or released at maturity from other KuCoin Earn products does not create an eligible external deposit.
## Reward Distribution
KCUSD base rewards continue to be distributed under the product rules. Campaign bonus rewards are calculated separately after your individual 30-day observation period and distributed in KCUSD in batches.
The first batch will be distributed within 10 days after registration closes to eligible users who have completed their observation periods. Users whose observation periods have not yet ended will be included in subsequent batches after completion and eligibility verification.
Holdings above the campaign reward principal may continue to earn base rewards under the product rules, but the excess does not qualify for this campaign’s bonus APR.

Exchange/platform: KuCoin
Headline: You can continue earning a est. 4% KCUSD APR rewards every day!
Start: not stated · End: not stated
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
KCUSD is now available as a margin asset in KuCoin Unified Trading Account (UTA). This feature is available to all KuCoin VIP users at VIP 1 and above. Eligible users can transfer KCUSD from their Funding Account to UTA and use it as margin in supported trading scenarios.
Eligible KCUSD units held in UTA continue earning up to 4% APR under the applicable product rules. Rewards are credited daily to the Funding Account in KCUSD units and automatically added to the subsequent reward calculation balance.
This upgrade connects earning and trading without requiring users to redeem KCUSD or convert it into another margin asset first.
## Key Benefits
Trade While Earning 4% APR
Eligible KCUSD units held in UTA continue earning.
Daily Rewards With Automatic Compounding
Rewards are credited daily to the Funding Account and automatically added to the subsequent reward calculation balance.
Transfer KCUSD Directly to UTA
Move KCUSD between the Funding Account and UTA without redeeming or converting it into another margin asset first.
## How to Use
Subscribe to KCUSD through KuCoin Earn at a 1:1 ratio using USDT, USDC, or USDG with no subscription fee.
Select Transfer on the Assets page and move KCUSD from the Funding Account to UTA.
Use KCUSD as margin in supported UTA trading scenarios.
View your margin assets in UTA and daily rewards on the KCUSD asset page.
## How to Redeem
Make sure the KCUSD to be redeemed is not required to meet current margin requirements.
Transfer KCUSD from UTA back to the Funding Account.
Open the KCUSD product page and submit a redemption request.
Redemptions are generally settled in the original subscription asset, subject to the product page and terms; this is not guaranteed.
## Important Notes
The 4% APR is not fixed or guaranteed. The actual APR displayed on the KCUSD product page prevails.
Eligible KCUSD units start accruing rewards on T+1 after subscription, with the first reward generally credited on T+2.
Rewards generated by KCUSD held in UTA are credited to the Funding Account.
Some or all KCUSD may be unavailable for transfer while required to meet margin requirements.
If losses, liabilities, or liquidation occur, KCUSD may be disposed of under the applicable UTA risk-control and liquidation rules.
This feature is currently available to users at VIP 1 and above. Availability remains subject to the user’s jurisdiction and account status.
Risk Notice
KuCoin does not promise fixed rewards or guaranteed returns. The autual APR displayed on the KCUSD product page prevails. The margin value, uasge limits, supported scenarios, and transfer conditions of KCUSD as trading margin are subject to the UTA page and applicable rules. Using KCUSD as margin involves trading, leverage, and liquidation risks, and may result in asset losses. The feature will be rolled out in phases to eligible users. Users should fully understand the product rules before making any decision, proceed prudently, and bear all the risks. KuCoin is not responsible for any investment loss.

OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance is excited to announce this week’s Binance Starter Carnival promotion on Simple Earn Flexible Products for all eligible new users*! Eligible new users who complete any amount of deposit can get an exclusive 15% Bonus Tiered APR rewards for 7 days on USDT Flexible Products on top of Real-Time APR rewards.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-23 13:00:00 (UTC) to 2027-01-31 23:59:59 (UTC)
Note: This offer is only available to users in Brazil. Only users who have completed identity verification (KYC) with Brazil as their KYC country/region are eligible. Users may check USDT Flexible Products to see offer details.
## Reward Structure
The below table shows progressive tiers. The bonus APR is calculated cumulatively, rather than applying a single rate to eligible users’ entire subscription amount.
Digital Asset | Duration | APR During the Promotion Period | Minimum Subscription Limit per Eligible User | Maximum Subscription Limit per Eligible User
USDT | 7 days | Tier Range: Subscription Amount ≤ 200 USDT | Tier Range: Subscription Amount > 200 USDT | 0.1 USDT | Unlimited
Real-Time APR + 15% Bonus Tiered APR (0 - 200 USDT) | Real-Time APR
Subscribe Now
## Please Note
It may take up to 5 to 10 minutes before eligible users can see and subscribe to the promotion on the USDT Flexible Products page.
Subscription Format: Maximum seven (7) days of subscription period. Complete subscription on a first-come, first-served basis in accordance with the terms above.
The 7-day offer starts from the day that eligible users subscribe to USDT Flexible Products.
## APR Rewards Distribution:
Bonus Tiered APR: Distributed to users’ Spot Accounts on a daily basis. The first reward will be given the day after accrual starts (two days after subscription).
Real-Time APR: Accrued and directly accumulated in users’ Earn Accounts every minute.
The special Bonus Tiered APR reward is only effective for 7 days from the subscription date and is only applicable to the user’s first 200 USDT subscribed to USDT Flexible Products during the Promotion Period. Any subscription amount exceeding 200 USDT will only earn Real-Time APR rewards.
Eligible users can still receive the Bonus APR reward once they subscribe to USDT Flexible Products during the Promotion Period, even if the remaining 7-day period extends beyond the Promotion Period.
## How to Get Started with USDT Flexible Products
Step 1. Newly-registered, verified users can add funds through any of the following channels to be eligible for the USDT special offer:
Crypto Deposit: Complete your first deposit via Crypto Deposit with a minimum amount of $1 equivalent.
P2P Buy: Complete your first crypto purchase via P2P Buy with a minimum amount of $1 equivalent.
Fiat Deposit/Buy Crypto: Complete your first deposit via Fiat Deposit or your first crypto purchase via Buy Crypto with a minimum amount of $1 equivalent.
Note: Purchases made via Fiat balance in your Binance account will not be considered as an eligible action.
Step 2. Go to [Simple Earn], and search for USDT.
Step 3. Select “Flexible”, and subscribe to USDT Simple Earn Flexible Products to start earning exclusive APR rewards!
## Terms & Conditions
The promotion is available for all newly registered users in Brazil, who registered on the Binance platform after 2026-11-23 13:00:00 (UTC) and whose identity verification country is Brazil.
Only users who complete identity verification during the Promotion Period can qualify for rewards in the Promotion, and only master accounts qualify for rewards in the Promotion. Sub-accounts are not eligible to receive rewards.
The products or features referred to above may not be available in your region. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance services in each country from which the services are accessed.
Changes to the Binance Simple Earn Rewards Rate will be published on the Platform from time to time. Please refer to Binance Simple Earn Terms & Conditions and Risk Warning for more information prior to using Binance Simple Earn.
## Rewards:
Real-Time APR is subject to change every minute, please refer to the respective product page(s) for accurate information. Real-Time APR rewards are accrued and directly accumulated in users’ Earn Accounts every minute.
Bonus Tiered APR is offered as an additional reward on top of Real-Time APR. Upon subscription, Bonus Tiered APR rewards start to accrue the next day starting from 00:00 (UTC) based on the snapshot of your subscribed amounts to the Flexible Product of the day, which will be taken randomly between 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC) daily. Rewards will start to be distributed the following day after accrual starts between 00:00 (UTC) and 08:00 (UTC) to the user’s Spot Account.
Any redemption of Flexible Products between 00:00:00 (UTC) and 00:00:00 (UTC) of the following day will stop the accrual of Bonus Tiered APR rewards on the redeemed amount for that day.
Redemptions of Flexible Products will be processed starting with assets that have accrued rewards. Users can check the rewards history from the Earn History.
Bonus Tiered APR rewards are calculated based on the subscribed amounts and are subject to the respective tier limit for each token. Please refer to this FAQ for more details.
Eligible users who subscribe to USDT Simple Earn Flexible Products promotion will receive both Real-Time APR and Bonus Tiered APR rewards for up to 7 days for USDT during the Promotion Period. Before the Promotion Period ends, users can enjoy the bonus apr rate within the 7-day period after the first subscription. Redemption within the 7-day period will terminate the reward accrual of the Bonus Tiered APR rewards from the redemption day. After the Promotion Period ends, users will only be entitled to Real-Time APR rewards.
Example: New User A subscribes to USDT Flexible Products on 2026-11-26, redeems on 2026-11-29, and resubscribes on 2026-11-30. Bonus Tiered APR rewards will accrue on 2026-11-27, 2026-11-28, and 2026-10-01, and be distributed to User A on 2026-11-28, 2026-11-29, and 2026-12-02. Bonus Tiered APR rewards are calculated based on the subscribed amounts and are subject to the respective tier limit for each token. Please refer to this FAQ for more details.
APR rewards are distributed from Binance’s own funds, and are determined based on the assessment and evaluation of prevailing market conditions. This Promotion is not associated with the issuer of USDT in any manner.
The Promotion’s subscription amount of each user has an upper limit. When the upper limit is reached, users will no longer be able to subscribe.
A large amount of redemption requests might delay redemption temporarily. Redemptions may resume upon return of liquidity.
Users can view their Flexible Products assets by going to Assets > Earn > Simple Earn.
Redemption time for Flexible Products subscriptions: Instant.
